message.title: A message from Antares
message.body: I build AI products by treating myself like one — versioned, measured, always shipping. Right now I'm open to AI PM roles at top product orgs, founder conversations in AI infra & agents, and 0→1 contract work. Tell me what you're building.

update.text: I'm working on ApplyMint, SusFix and the Kaboo token-efficiency leaderboard.
